unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Current bounded Codex CLI re-review found no local DOC/DOCX/XLS/XLSX/archive/image supplementary bytes. The packet supplementary_original files are symlinks to landed .bin files whose file type is Springer HTML; those pages link to 18_2020_3755_MOESM1_ESM.docx, but exact-name and DOI-scoped local searches found no DOCX under packet, paper source, landed_assets, downloaded_assets, landed_assets_current, or merged_amp_corpus surfaces checked locally.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: The true Supplementary file1 DOCX cannot be source-reviewed locally; supplementary-dependent tables/figures remain uncertified, so publication-grade acceptance remains blocked.
